How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
Standard orders are typically processed and shipped within 2-3 business days. After shipment, standard delivery usually takes:

3-7 business days within the US and Canada
14-20 business days internationally

Business days exclude weekends and holidays. These are estimates and may vary due to carrier volume, weather, or busy promotional periods. Custom and pre-order items may require 4-6 weeks before shipping.
